tool_args.rationale: The paid probe directly observed the reversal: y/u_now fell from +0.186 at H=7.38 to −0.489 at H=15.19 and −0.794 at H=21.1. Together with the rising short-horizon response, these observations constrain a fast positive contribution opposed by a slower negative contribution. Fit both amplitudes and both time scales jointly, then submit the model for fresh confirmation against the 0.045 RMSE tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All paid rows have zero sink gradient, so the sink coefficient is unidentifiable. The additional saturating input term is not needed to explain the observed reversal.
The normalized pilot response already bends away from its initial linear rise, while the late observations trace a decline rather than supplying evidence of a cycle.
Five short-horizon points and three long-horizon points already sample both time scales, including the forecast horizon. Test the fitted law on fresh data before buying more trajectory points.
